bead.title: Add flaky-rate repeat harness with release suite-list support
bead.description:
Purpose: provide repeatability measurement for release and nightly suites.

TP-003 requires a flaky rate below 0.1 percent over 100 repeats. With 100 repeats, that resolution means any single failure is 1 percent and fails the gate; only 0/100 failures pass this strict check.

In-scope files:
- scripts/ci/repeat-suite.sh
- scripts/ci/repeat-suite-report.py
- scripts/ci/repeat-suite-list-example.toml
- crates/pqueue-core/tests/flaky_repeat_harness_tests.rs
- repeat harness fixtures under scripts/ci/fixtures/repeat/

Out of scope: choosing the final release suite list; release/nightly workflows.
bead.acceptance:
1. `bash scripts/ci/repeat-suite.sh --count 3 -- cargo test -p pqueue-core core_domain_tests` passes.
2. `bash scripts/ci/repeat-suite.sh --count 3 --suite-list scripts/ci/repeat-suite-list-example.toml` passes.
3. `bash scripts/ci/repeat-suite.sh --count 100 --max-flaky-rate 0.000999 -- cargo test -p pqueue-core core_domain_tests` passes only with zero failures.
4. The report includes run count, failures, flaky rate, and failing selector names.
